text: めの　まえを　チョロチョロうるせえ！

patterns.name: 〜を (moving through)
patterns.explanation: を with a place shows the space something moves around in. めの まえを チョロチョロ = 'scurrying around in front of my eyes'.

patterns.name: 〜い
patterns.explanation: Rough male speech turns the ending さい into せえ, so this is うるさい said in a tough way. うるせえ = 'you're annoying'.
